title: Leading term of a multi-twisted Euler characteristic via top-dimensional components
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $X$ be a proper scheme over $k$ [def-weil-proper-morphism], let $\mathcal F$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and let $\mathcal L_1,\ldots,\mathcal L_r$ be invertible $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-sc-invertible-module]. Let $d=\dim\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], let $Z_1,\ldots,Z_s$ be the irreducible components of $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)$ of dimension $d$ [def-weil-irreducible-components], each with its reduced induced integral closed-subscheme structure $\iota_i:Z_i\hookrightarrow X$ [def-pc-integral-scheme] [def-weil-closed-immersion], let $\xi_i$ be the generic point of $Z_i$ [def-sc-generic-point], and put $m_i=\mathrm{length}_{\mathcal O_{X,\xi_i}}(\mathcal F_{\xi_i})$ [def-weil-pbc-module-length]. Then each $m_i$ is a positive integer, and $(n_1,\ldots,n_r)\mapsto\chi(X,\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal L_1^{\otimes n_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes\mathcal L_r^{\otimes n_r})-\sum_{i=1}^s m_i\,\chi(X,\iota_{i*}\mathcal O_{Z_i}\otimes\mathcal L_1^{\otimes n_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes\mathcal L_r^{\otimes n_r})$ [def-pc-euler-characteristic] is a numerical polynomial in $n_1,\ldots,n_r$ of total degree $<d$ (the zero polynomial when $d=0$).

source.place: Tag 0BEN (Varieties, label lemma-numerical-polynomial-leading-term, varieties.tex line 10290); the Euler characteristics on $Z_i$ written as Euler characteristics on $X$ of the pushforwards

proof.text: For every integral closed subscheme $Z\subset X$ of dimension $d$ with generic point $\xi$, the finite stalk $\mathcal F_\xi$ has support contained in $\{\xi\}$. If this stalk is nonzero, [lem-sc-generic-stalk-finite-length] gives a finite length $m_Z$; if it is zero, set $m_Z=0$. Thus $m_Z=0$ unless $Z$ is one of the top-dimensional irreducible components $Z_i$, and $m_Z$ is positive for each $Z_i$. Define $E(\mathcal F)$ to be the Euler-characteristic expression in the statement, equivalently summing $m_Z\,\chi(Z,\mathcal L_1^{\otimes n_1}|_Z\otimes\cdots\otimes\mathcal L_r^{\otimes n_r}|_Z)$ over all such $Z$. For a short exact sequence of coherent modules whose supports have dimension at most $d$, [lem-pc-euler-additive] makes the first term additive and [lem-weil-pbc-length-additive-short-exact] makes every generic length additive, so $E$ is additive.

source.place: Tag 0BEN proof, first two paragraphs: finite generic lengths and additivity of E

proof.text: Properness over the field makes $X$ of finite type over the Noetherian scheme $\operatorname{Spec}(k)$, hence Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-filtration-integral-subschemes] to obtain a coherent filtration whose successive quotients are $(V_j\to X)_*\mathcal I_j$ for integral closed subschemes $V_j$ and nonzero coherent ideal sheaves $\mathcal I_j$. Every $V_j$ lies in $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)$, so $\dim V_j\le d$. By additivity from step 1, it suffices to prove the assertion for each such quotient.

If $\dim V<d$, then the first Euler-characteristic term for $(V\to X)_*\mathcal I$ is a numerical polynomial of degree at most $\dim V<d$ by [lem-sc-snapper-numerical-polynomial]. Its generic stalk is zero at every integral closed subscheme of dimension $d$, because the support is contained in $V$, so all terms in the defining sum vanish; hence $E((V\to X)_*\mathcal I)$ has degree $<d$.

Assume $\dim V=d$. The exact sequence $0\to\mathcal I\to\mathcal O_V\to\mathcal O_V/\mathcal I\to0$, pushed forward to $X$ using [lem-sc-closed-immersion-pushforward-exact] and tensored by the invertible twists, is exact. The quotient is supported on a proper closed subset of the integral $d$-dimensional $V$, so its support has dimension $<d$; step 3 applies to it. For $(V\to X)_*\mathcal O_V$, the only nonzero generic length is $1$ at $V$, and [lem-pc-projection-formula] together with [lem-sc-cohomology-closed-immersion-pushforward] identifies its twisted cohomology with the cohomology on $V$ of the restricted twists, so its $E$ is identically zero. Additivity of Euler characteristics from [lem-pc-euler-additive] now gives the degree-$<d$ assertion for $(V\to X)_*\mathcal I$.

source.place: Tag 0BEN proof, dim(V)=d case and projection formula paragraph

proof.text: Summing the degree-$<d$ conclusions for the filtration quotients using step 1 proves that the displayed difference is a numerical polynomial of total degree $<d$. The generic stalks at the top-dimensional components are nonzero finite modules, so their lengths $m_i$ are positive integers by step 1.
